entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add EmitDifferenceOptions.DisallowExplicitMethodImplementations #81305
  • Improve syntax highlighting for file-based apps directives #81303
  • ExtractMethodCodeRefactoringProvider Threw Exception #81296

Closed

  • Parenthes completion doesn't work sometimes #61680
    Backlog
  • `Invert if` results in incorrect formatting when applied to multi-line `if`-statement #77181
    Backlog
  • CS0452 and CS0718 error sometimes reported on unintuitive locations #65515
    Backlog
  • Compiler produces weird error in bad pattern matching #61245
    Backlog
  • Missing warning with default expression converted to tuple #35815
    Backlog
  • Unhelpful diagnostic when using null in user-defined operator == #26834
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Update Roslyn LSP server to .net10 #81308
  • Only treat a file with directives as an FBP #81307
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Stack Trace Explorer - Change color for text that is unlinked #81306
    Area-IDE
  • EnC: Block additions to MethodImpl table when targeting .NET Framework #81304
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Improve location of error diagnostic when encountering errant operator token #81295
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve diagnostic for != operator in patterns #81294
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce cascading errors when record inherits from non-record #81293
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Update Compiler Test Plan with IL verification guidance #81292
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • Document excerpt for Razor, and fix Find All Refs #81291
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use `SignatureTypeEncoder.TypedReference()` #81290
    Area-Compilers
  • Avoid `virtual` implementations for `AddSynthesizedAttributes` #81289
    Area-Compilers
  • Add more specific diagnostic message for conditional-access on unconstrained generic #81288
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Remove an explicit package version that was only present in the release/dev18.0 branch #81299
  • [Backport 17.12] Use pipeline parameters #81298
  • [Backport 17.8] Use pipeline parameters #81302
  • [Backport 17.10] Use pipeline parameters #81301
  • [Backport 17.11] Use pipeline parameters #81300
  • Fix parenthesis brace completion for nested invocations in control flow statements and other parenthesized contexts #81242
    VSCode, Next
  • Fix "Invert if" losing indentation on multi-line conditions #81249
    VSCode, Next
  • [release/dev17.14] [release/dev18.0] Fix parameter syntax in pipeline definition #81297
  • Fix parameter syntax in pipeline definition #81271
    Next

Updated

  • Add initial support for Union matching #81188
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
  • Unsafe evolution: require unsafe for some pointer operations #81240
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Use ArrayExpansion for `[InlineArray]` structs #81254
    Area-Compilers, Area-Interactive, Community
  • Improve async iterator diagnostic by removing redundant error #81282
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Async Streams
  • Fix redundant error reporting in deconstruction assignments #81281
    VSCode
  • Add replacement property names to VB syntax obsolete attributes #81272
    Area-Compilers
  • Include file based program sources #81284
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Extensions: fix issue with paramref #81269
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Extensions: xml docs completion #81274
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • Extensions: rewrite extension references in EE #81263
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Use work done progress to handle restore server side #81233
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Target typed switch expression recovery #81270
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Fix null reference crash in CheckUnderspecifiedGenericExtension for namespace-level extensions #80929
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Avoid premature full binding of a receiver as a value in the process of binding possible type-or-value receiver (so-called “Color Color” scenario) #80978
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error recovery for incomplete attribute in a type-parameter. #81231
    Area-IDE, Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Fix CS1003 error message when expression follows identifier without '=' #81285
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Suppress ERR_BadRetType and ERR_MethDelegateMismatch for delegate conversions with omitted type arguments #81278
  • Simplifying internal structure and logic for the SyntaxNodeCache #80825
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error recovery in parenthesized constructs #81279
    Area-Compilers
  • Prefer expanded form for error reporting when params arguments are convertible #81276
    Area-Compilers
  • Suppress CS0119 when CS0075 is reported for negative cast #81283
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error message for misplaced variable designator in property patterns #81287
    Area-Compilers
  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81058
    Area-Compilers, Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Collection Arguments
